inputs: base and head commits, or a PR number
outputs: taxonomy, fold and guard test results
answer-key category errors before and after, tuning and holdout apart
live impact per category: still ok / would re-file / would fail, with spot checks
budget: deterministic, no paid calls; unit tests plus one read-only query per touched category
triggering_workflows: PR that bumps CATEGORY_GUARD_VERSION or FOLD_RULES_VERSION
PR that edits FEE_FAMILIES, CANONICAL_KEY_MAP, CATEGORY_GUARD_RULES, RETIRED_CATEGORIES or SPLIT_CATEGORIES
report of a fee under the wrong heading
failure_behavior: Failing tests or a rise in tuning-set category errors are reported as findings with no pass verdict; a step that cannot run is reported as not run.
approval_requirements: None to run (read-only). A taxonomy change itself is a code PR; a change to the 50 types is James's decision.
abstain_when: the change touches only display names or colors
no live fees exist in the touched categories
answer keys do not cover the touched categories (report key result as unknown)
the base commit cannot be checked out or tests cannot run
